hypothesis: Risk-weighted selective-negative stop learning using richer but prefix-local evidence will avoid the F13 premature-positive false negatives and retain at least 15% recurrent-step savings on new longer typed chains, with >=95% accuracy and significant utility advantage over a train-calibrated confidence rule.

training.policy: 8->12 tanh->1 trained negative-stop safety classifier, 180 Adam epochs lr .025; 25x false-safe penalty, training-only hindsight target
training.features: Seven Y-F13 prefix scores/activations/budget features plus max NEXT requested role compatibility against current observed static edge-role tags; no future rollout or graph family
training.select: train-only >=99.5% accuracy and <=0.5% false-negative then maximize recurrent-step savings; default never-stop if no candidate qualifies
training.confidence_control: train-only calibration of prefix score to same 99.5%/0.5% constraints

accounting.reported_savings: recurrent steps only, does not include O(12) per-step feature computation; do not claim wall-time speedup
